nodes.zh: 2.8.4 运行时应用程序编程接口

nodes.en: CUDA supports a set of API functions to provide services to CUDA C programs. The services that we discussed in this chapter are 【1】cudaMalloc【/1】, 【2】cudaFree【/2】, and 【3】cudaMemcpy【/3】 functions. These functions are called by the host code to allocate device global memory, deallocate device global memory, and transfer data between host and device on behalf of the calling program, respectively. The reader is referred to the CUDA C Programming Guide for other CUDA API functions.
nodes.zh: CUDA 支持一组为 CUDA C 程序提供服务的 API 函数。本章我们讨论的服务包括【1】cudaMalloc【/1】、【2】cudaFree【/2】和【3】cudaMemcpy【/3】函数。主机代码调用这些函数，分别代表调用程序分配设备全局内存、释放设备全局内存，以及在主机与设备之间传输数据。其他 CUDA API 函数请读者参阅 CUDA C 编程指南。

nodes.en: Our goal for this chapter is to introduce the core concepts of CUDA C and the essential CUDA extensions to C for writing a simple CUDA C program. The chapter is by no means a comprehensive account of all CUDA features. Some of these features will be covered in the remainder of the book. However, our emphasis will be on the key parallel computing concepts that are supported by these features. We will introduce only the CUDA C features that are needed in our code examples for parallel programming techniques. In general, we would like to encourage the reader to always consult the CUDA C Programming Guide for more details of the CUDA C features.
nodes.zh: 本章的目标是介绍 CUDA C 的核心概念，以及编写简单 CUDA C 程序所需的 CUDA 对 C 的基本扩展。本章绝不是对所有 CUDA 特性的全面介绍，其中一些特性会在本书其余部分介绍。不过，我们的重点是这些特性所支持的关键并行计算概念。我们只会引入代码示例中演示并行编程技术所需要的 CUDA C 特性。总的来说，我们鼓励读者随时查阅 CUDA C 编程指南，以了解 CUDA C 特性的更多细节。

nodes.en: 1. If we want to use each thread in a grid to calculate one output element of a vector addition, what would be the expression for mapping the thread/block indices to the data index (i)?【M1】
nodes.zh: 1. 如果我们希望用网格中的每个线程计算向量加法的一个输出元素，那么把线程/线程块索引映射到数据索引 (i) 的表达式应该是什么？【M1】

nodes.en: 2. Assume that we want to use each thread to calculate two adjacent elements of a vector addition. What would be the expression for mapping the thread/block indices to the data index (i) of the first element to be processed by a thread?【M1】
nodes.zh: 2. 假设我们希望用每个线程计算向量加法中两个相邻的元素。那么，把线程/线程块索引映射到某个线程要处理的第一个元素的数据索引 (i) 的表达式应该是什么？【M1】

nodes.en: 3. We want to use each thread to calculate two elements of a vector addition. Each thread block processes 【1】2*blockDim.x【/1】 consecutive elements that form two sections. All threads in each block will process a section first, each processing one element. They will then all move to the next section, each processing one element. Assume that variable i should be the index for the first element to be processed by a thread. What would be the expression for mapping the thread/block indices to data index of the first element?【M2】
nodes.zh: 3. 我们希望用每个线程计算向量加法的两个元素。每个线程块处理【1】2*blockDim.x【/1】个连续元素，这些元素构成两个区段。块中的所有线程先处理第一个区段，每个线程处理一个元素；然后所有线程一起移到下一个区段，每个线程再处理一个元素。假设变量 i 应该是某个线程要处理的第一个元素的索引。那么，把线程/线程块索引映射到第一个元素的数据索引的表达式应该是什么？【M2】

nodes.en: 4. For a vector addition, assume that the vector length is 8000, each thread calculates one output element, and the thread block size is 1024 threads. The programmer configures the kernel call to have a minimum number of thread blocks to cover all output elements. How many threads will be in the grid?【M1】
nodes.zh: 4. 对于向量加法，假设向量长度为 8000，每个线程计算一个输出元素，线程块大小为 1024 个线程。程序员把核函数调用配置为使用最少的线程块数以覆盖所有输出元素。那么网格中将有多少个线程？【M1】

nodes.en: 5. 5. If we want to allocate an array of v integer elements in the CUDA device 【1】global【/1】 memory, what would be an appropriate expression for the second argument of the 【2】cudaMalloc【/2】 call?【M3】
nodes.zh: 5. 5. 如果我们要在 CUDA 设备的【1】全局【/1】内存中分配一个包含 v 个整数元素的数组，那么【2】cudaMalloc【/2】调用的第二个参数用什么表达式合适？【M3】
